package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	ProjectAuthoringCreateSchemaV1      = "project-authoring-flow-create.v1"
	ProjectAuthoringConfirmSchemaV1     = "project-authoring-flow-confirm.v1"
	ProjectAuthoringPublishSchemaV1     = "project-authoring-flow-publish.v1"
	ProjectAuthoringInputSchemaV1       = "planner-project-authoring-input.v1"
	ProjectAuthoringProfileSchemaV1     = "planner-project-authoring-profile.v1"
	TZPlanningRequestSchemaV2           = "tz-planning-request.v2"
	TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1           = "learning-workspace-authoring-intent.v1"
	TZPublicationResultSchemaV1         = "practice-task-publication-result.v1"
	TZVerificationReceiptSchemaV1       = "validation-contract-verification-receipt.v1"
	ProjectAuthoringFailureOwnerStale   = "OWNER_STATE_STALE"
	ProjectAuthoringFailureOwnerInvalid = "OWNER_STATE_INVALID"
	ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid    = "TZ_RESPONSE_INVALID"
	ProjectAuthoringFailureTZFailed     = "TZ_AUTHORING_FAILED"
	ProjectAuthoringFailureAttempts     = "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED"
)

type ProjectAuthoringStatus string

const (
	ProjectAuthoringProposed  ProjectAuthoringStatus = "PROPOSED"
	ProjectAuthoringConfirmed ProjectAuthoringStatus = "CONFIRMED"
	ProjectAuthoringAuthoring ProjectAuthoringStatus = "AUTHORING"
	ProjectAuthoringReady     ProjectAuthoringStatus = "READY"
	ProjectAuthoringPublished ProjectAuthoringStatus = "PUBLISHED"
	ProjectAuthoringStaged    ProjectAuthoringStatus = "STAGED"
	ProjectAuthoringFailed    ProjectAuthoringStatus = "FAILED"
)

type ProjectAuthoringCreateRequestV1 struct {
	Schema string `json:"schema"`
}

type ProjectAuthoringConfirmRequestV1 struct {
	Schema string `json:"schema"`
}

type ProjectAuthoringPublishRequestV1 struct {
	Schema string `json:"schema"`
}

type ProjectAuthoringInputV1 struct {
	Schema    string      `json:"schema"`
	GoalCode  string      `json:"goal_code"`
	Locale    string      `json:"locale"`
	Stacks    []string    `json:"stacks"`
	Targets   []TargetRef `json:"targets"`
	Manifest  string      `json:"manifest"`
	InputHash string      `json:"input_hash"`
}

type TZAuthoringRequestV2 struct {
	Schema        string                `json:"schema"`
	Mode          string                `json:"mode"`
	Manifest      string                `json:"manifest"`
	Locale        string                `json:"locale"`
	Source        TZAuthoringSource     `json:"source"`
	Hints         TZClassificationHints `json:"classification_hints"`
	Orchestration TZAuthoringIntentV1   `json:"orchestration"`
}

type TZAuthoringSource struct {
	Type       string `json:"type"`
	Anonymized bool   `json:"anonymized"`
}

type TZClassificationHints struct {
	Stacks []string `json:"stacks,omitempty"`
}

type TZAuthoringIntentV1 struct {
	Schema                string `json:"schema"`
	Trigger               string `json:"trigger"`
	CorrelationID         string `json:"correlation_id"`
	SurfaceClassification string `json:"surface_classification"`
}

type TZAuthoringJobStatus string

const (
	TZAuthoringPlanned    TZAuthoringJobStatus = "PLANNED"
	TZAuthoringGenerating TZAuthoringJobStatus = "GENERATING"
	TZAuthoringVerifying  TZAuthoringJobStatus = "VERIFYING"
	TZAuthoringReady      TZAuthoringJobStatus = "READY"
	TZAuthoringStaged     TZAuthoringJobStatus = "STAGED"
	TZAuthoringFailed     TZAuthoringJobStatus = "FAILED"
)

type TZAuthoringJob struct {
	ID                 string
	Status             TZAuthoringJobStatus
	Attempts           int
	FailureCode        string
	Intent             TZAuthoringIntentV1
	BlueprintDigest    string
	CandidateDigest    string
	ContractDigest     string
	CapabilitiesDigest string
	VerificationDigest string
	Publication        *ProjectPublicationReceiptV1
	Staging            *ProjectStagingReceiptV1
}

type ProjectStagingReceiptV1 struct {
	Schema          string    `json:"schema"`
	StagedID        string    `json:"staged_id"`
	AuthoringJobID  string    `json:"authoring_job_id"`
	State           string    `json:"state"`
	Created         bool      `json:"created"`
	FamilyKey       string    `json:"family_key"`
	VariantKey      string    `json:"variant_key"`
	CandidateDigest string    `json:"candidate_digest"`
	BlueprintDigest string    `json:"blueprint_digest"`
	CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

func ValidateProjectStagingReceipt(receipt ProjectStagingReceiptV1, job TZAuthoringJob) error {
	if receipt.Schema != "practice-task-staging-receipt.v1" || !validCoursePlanUUID(receipt.StagedID) ||
		receipt.AuthoringJobID != job.ID || receipt.State != "staged" || receipt.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		!boundedProjectKey(receipt.FamilyKey) || !boundedProjectKey(receipt.VariantKey) ||
		receipt.CandidateDigest != job.CandidateDigest || receipt.BlueprintDigest != job.BlueprintDigest ||
		!projectDigest(receipt.CandidateDigest) || !projectDigest(receipt.BlueprintDigest) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

type ProjectPublicationReceiptV1 struct {
	Schema             string `json:"schema"`
	RevisionID         string `json:"revision_id"`
	FamilyKey          string `json:"family_key"`
	VariantKey         string `json:"variant_key"`
	RevisionNumber     int    `json:"revision_number"`
	BlueprintDigest    string `json:"blueprint_digest"`
	CandidateDigest    string `json:"candidate_digest"`
	ContractDigest     string `json:"contract_digest"`
	CapabilitiesDigest string `json:"capabilities_digest"`
	AuthoringJobID     string `json:"authoring_job_id"`
}

type ProjectAuthoringFlow struct {
	ID                         string
	StudentID                  string
	LearningPathID             string
	IdempotencyKey             string
	RequestHash                string
	Status                     ProjectAuthoringStatus
	Version                    int64
	LearningPathVersion        int64
	PathSnapshotDigest         string
	AuthoringProfileVersion    int64
	AuthoringProfileDigest     string
	GoalCode                   string
	Input                      ProjectAuthoringInputV1
	AuthoringRequest           TZAuthoringRequestV2
	AuthoringInputDigest       string
	ConfirmationIdempotencyKey string
	ConfirmationDigest         string
	ConfirmedAt                *time.Time
	TZAuthoringJobID           string
	TZJobStatus                TZAuthoringJobStatus
	ReadyBlueprintDigest       string
	ReadyCandidateDigest       string
	ReadyContractDigest        string
	ReadyCapabilitiesDigest    string
	ReadyVerificationDigest    string
	ReadyAt                    *time.Time
	PublicationIdempotencyKey  string
	PublicationRequestDigest   string
	PublicationRequestedAt     *time.Time
	Publication                *ProjectPublicationReceiptV1
	PublicationReceiptDigest   string
	PublishedAt                *time.Time
	Staging                    *ProjectStagingReceiptV1
	FailureCode                string
	Attempts                   int
	ClaimToken                 string
	LeaseUntil                 *time.Time
	NextAttemptAt              time.Time
	CreatedAt                  time.Time
	UpdatedAt                  time.Time
}

func NewProjectAuthoringFlow(
	id, studentID, learningPathID, idempotencyKey string,
	profile StudentPlanningProfile,
	path LearningPathPlanningState,
	now time.Time,
) (ProjectAuthoringFlow, error) {
	if !validCoursePlanUUID(id) || !validCoursePlanUUID(studentID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(learningPathID) ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(idempotencyKey) || path.StudentID != studentID || path.LearningPathID != learningPathID {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
	}
	profile, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(profile)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	path, err = NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	if err := ValidateCurrentProjectAuthoringOwnerState(profile, path); err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	targets, err := projectTargets(path.Items)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	locale, err := projectAuthoringLocale(profile.PreferredLanguage)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	stacks, err := projectAuthoringStacks(profile.DesiredStacks)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	profileDigest, err := ProjectAuthoringProfileDigest(profile)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	manifest, err := projectAuthoringManifest(path.GoalCode, targets)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	input := ProjectAuthoringInputV1{
		Schema: ProjectAuthoringInputSchemaV1, GoalCode: path.GoalCode, Locale: locale,
		Stacks: append([]string(nil), stacks...), Targets: targets, Manifest: manifest,
	}
	input.InputHash, err = ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
		Schema   string      `json:"schema"`
		GoalCode string      `json:"goal_code"`
		Locale   string      `json:"locale"`
		Stacks   []string    `json:"stacks"`
		Targets  []TargetRef `json:"targets"`
		Manifest string      `json:"manifest"`
	}{input.Schema, input.GoalCode, input.Locale, input.Stacks, input.Targets, input.Manifest})
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	request := TZAuthoringRequestV2{
		Schema: TZPlanningRequestSchemaV2, Mode: "private", Manifest: manifest, Locale: locale,
		Source: TZAuthoringSource{Type: "user_intent", Anonymized: true},
		Hints:  TZClassificationHints{Stacks: append([]string(nil), stacks...)},
		Orchestration: TZAuthoringIntentV1{
			Schema: TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1, Trigger: "planner_recommendation",
			CorrelationID: id, SurfaceClassification: "project",
		},
	}
	authoringDigest, err := ProjectAuthoringDigest(request)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	pathDigest, err := ProjectPathSnapshotDigest(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	requestHash, err := ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
		Schema         string `json:"schema"`
		StudentID      string `json:"student_id"`
		LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id"`
	}{ProjectAuthoringCreateSchemaV1, studentID, learningPathID})
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	now = now.UTC()
	flow := ProjectAuthoringFlow{
		ID: id, StudentID: studentID, LearningPathID: learningPathID, IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
		RequestHash: requestHash, Status: ProjectAuthoringProposed, Version: 1,
		LearningPathVersion: path.PathVersion, PathSnapshotDigest: pathDigest, GoalCode: path.GoalCode,
		AuthoringProfileVersion: profile.OnboardingVersion, AuthoringProfileDigest: profileDigest,
		Input: input, AuthoringRequest: request, AuthoringInputDigest: authoringDigest,
		NextAttemptAt: now, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	return NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(flow)
}

func ValidateCurrentProjectAuthoringOwnerState(profile StudentPlanningProfile, path LearningPathPlanningState) error {
	normalizedProfile, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(profile)
	if err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	normalizedPath, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if normalizedProfile.OnboardingVersion < 1 || normalizedPath.Status != "ACTIVE" || !normalizedPath.IsSelected ||
		normalizedProfile.LearningPathVersion != normalizedPath.PathVersion ||
		normalizedProfile.LearningPathCourseID != normalizedPath.CourseID ||
		normalizedProfile.LearningPathGoalCode != normalizedPath.GoalCode ||
		normalizedProfile.LearningPathRevision != normalizedPath.CourseFingerprint ||
		normalizedProfile.GoalCode != normalizedPath.GoalCode {
		return ErrConflict
	}
	_, err = projectTargets(normalizedPath.Items)
	return err
}

func ProjectAuthoringProfileDigest(profile StudentPlanningProfile) (string, error) {
	profile, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(profile)
	if err != nil || profile.OnboardingVersion < 1 {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	locale, err := projectAuthoringLocale(profile.PreferredLanguage)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	stacks, err := projectAuthoringStacks(profile.DesiredStacks)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
		Schema            string   `json:"schema"`
		ProfileVersion    string   `json:"profile_version"`
		OnboardingVersion int64    `json:"onboarding_version"`
		Locale            string   `json:"locale"`
		DesiredStackCodes []string `json:"desired_stack_codes"`
	}{ProjectAuthoringProfileSchemaV1, profile.ProfileVersion, profile.OnboardingVersion, locale, stacks})
}

func ProjectPathSnapshotDigest(path LearningPathPlanningState) (string, error) {
	path, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
		Schema               string             `json:"schema"`
		StudentID            string             `json:"student_id"`
		LearningPathID       string             `json:"learning_path_id"`
		CourseID             string             `json:"course_id"`
		GoalCode             string             `json:"goal_code"`
		CourseFingerprint    string             `json:"course_fingerprint"`
		Status               string             `json:"status"`
		IsSelected           bool               `json:"is_selected"`
		PathVersion          int64              `json:"path_version"`
		JourneyVersion       int64              `json:"journey_version"`
		PlannerPolicyVersion string             `json:"planner_policy_version"`
		Items                []LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	}{path.Schema, path.StudentID, path.LearningPathID, path.CourseID, path.GoalCode,
		path.CourseFingerprint, path.Status, path.IsSelected, path.PathVersion,
		path.JourneyVersion, path.PlannerPolicyVersion, path.Items})
}

func ProjectAuthoringDigest(value any) (string, error) {
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}

func ProjectConfirmationDigest(flow ProjectAuthoringFlow) (string, error) {
	return ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
		Schema             string `json:"schema"`
		FlowID             string `json:"flow_id"`
		StudentID          string `json:"student_id"`
		PathSnapshotDigest string `json:"path_snapshot_digest"`
		ProfileVersion     int64  `json:"authoring_profile_version"`
		ProfileDigest      string `json:"authoring_profile_digest"`
		AuthoringDigest    string `json:"authoring_input_digest"`
	}{ProjectAuthoringConfirmSchemaV1, flow.ID, flow.StudentID, flow.PathSnapshotDigest,
		flow.AuthoringProfileVersion, flow.AuthoringProfileDigest, flow.AuthoringInputDigest})
}

func ProjectPublicationRequestDigest(flow ProjectAuthoringFlow) (string, error) {
	return ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
		Schema             string `json:"schema"`
		FlowID             string `json:"flow_id"`
		AuthoringJobID     string `json:"authoring_job_id"`
		BlueprintDigest    string `json:"blueprint_digest"`
		CandidateDigest    string `json:"candidate_digest"`
		VerificationDigest string `json:"verification_digest"`
	}{ProjectAuthoringPublishSchemaV1, flow.ID, flow.TZAuthoringJobID, flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest,
		flow.ReadyCandidateDigest, flow.ReadyVerificationDigest})
}

func ProjectPublicationReceiptDigest(receipt ProjectPublicationReceiptV1) (string, error) {
	return ProjectAuthoringDigest(receipt)
}

func ValidateProjectPublicationReceipt(receipt ProjectPublicationReceiptV1, flow ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	if receipt.Schema != TZPublicationResultSchemaV1 || !validCoursePlanUUID(receipt.RevisionID) ||
		receipt.AuthoringJobID != flow.TZAuthoringJobID || receipt.RevisionNumber < 1 ||
		!boundedProjectKey(receipt.FamilyKey) || !boundedProjectKey(receipt.VariantKey) ||
		receipt.BlueprintDigest != flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest || receipt.CandidateDigest != flow.ReadyCandidateDigest ||
		receipt.ContractDigest != flow.ReadyContractDigest || receipt.CapabilitiesDigest != flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest ||
		!projectDigest(receipt.BlueprintDigest) || !projectDigest(receipt.CandidateDigest) ||
		!projectDigest(receipt.ContractDigest) || !projectDigest(receipt.CapabilitiesDigest) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateTZAuthoringJob(job TZAuthoringJob) error {
	if !validCoursePlanUUID(job.ID) || job.Attempts < 0 || !validTZAuthoringStatus(job.Status) ||
		job.Intent.Schema != TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1 || job.Intent.Trigger != "planner_recommendation" ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(job.Intent.CorrelationID) || job.Intent.SurfaceClassification != "project" {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	readyFields := []string{job.BlueprintDigest, job.CandidateDigest, job.ContractDigest, job.CapabilitiesDigest, job.VerificationDigest}
	if job.Status == TZAuthoringReady || job.Status == TZAuthoringStaged {
		for _, digest := range readyFields {
			if !projectDigest(digest) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
	} else {
		for _, digest := range readyFields {
			if digest != "" {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
		if job.Publication != nil {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if job.Status == TZAuthoringFailed && strings.TrimSpace(job.FailureCode) == "" {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if (job.Status == TZAuthoringStaged) != (job.Staging != nil) ||
		(job.Staging != nil && ValidateProjectStagingReceipt(*job.Staging, job) != nil) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateProjectTZAuthoringRequest(request TZAuthoringRequestV2) error {
	if request.Schema != TZPlanningRequestSchemaV2 || request.Mode != "private" || request.Manifest == "" ||
		len(request.Manifest) > 64<<10 || (request.Locale != "ru" && request.Locale != "en") ||
		request.Source.Type != "user_intent" || !request.Source.Anonymized || len(request.Hints.Stacks) == 0 ||
		!validProjectStacks(request.Hints.Stacks) ||
		request.Orchestration.Schema != TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1 || request.Orchestration.Trigger != "planner_recommendation" ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(request.Orchestration.CorrelationID) || request.Orchestration.SurfaceClassification != "project" {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(flow ProjectAuthoringFlow) (ProjectAuthoringFlow, error) {
	flow.ID = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ID)
	flow.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(flow.StudentID)
	flow.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(flow.LearningPathID)
	flow.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(flow.IdempotencyKey)
	flow.RequestHash = strings.TrimSpace(flow.RequestHash)
	flow.GoalCode = normalizeCode(flow.GoalCode)
	flow.AuthoringInputDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.AuthoringInputDigest)
	flow.PathSnapshotDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.PathSnapshotDigest)
	flow.AuthoringProfileDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.AuthoringProfileDigest)
	flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey)
	flow.ConfirmationDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ConfirmationDigest)
	flow.TZAuthoringJobID = strings.TrimSpace(flow.TZAuthoringJobID)
	flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest)
	flow.ReadyCandidateDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ReadyCandidateDigest)
	flow.ReadyContractDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ReadyContractDigest)
	flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest)
	flow.ReadyVerificationDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ReadyVerificationDigest)
	flow.PublicationIdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(flow.PublicationIdempotencyKey)
	flow.PublicationRequestDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.PublicationRequestDigest)
	flow.PublicationReceiptDigest = strings.TrimSpace(flow.PublicationReceiptDigest)
	flow.FailureCode = strings.TrimSpace(flow.FailureCode)
	flow.ClaimToken = strings.TrimSpace(flow.ClaimToken)
	if !validCoursePlanUUID(flow.ID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(flow.StudentID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(flow.LearningPathID) ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(flow.IdempotencyKey) || !projectDigest(flow.RequestHash) || !projectDigest(flow.PathSnapshotDigest) ||
		flow.AuthoringProfileVersion < 1 || !projectDigest(flow.AuthoringProfileDigest) ||
		!projectDigest(flow.AuthoringInputDigest) || flow.GoalCode == "" || len(flow.GoalCode) > 64 ||
		flow.LearningPathVersion < 1 || flow.Version < 1 || flow.Attempts < 0 || !validProjectAuthoringStatus(flow.Status) ||
		flow.CreatedAt.IsZero() || flow.UpdatedAt.Before(flow.CreatedAt) || flow.NextAttemptAt.IsZero() {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if err := validateProjectAuthoringInput(flow); err != nil {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	confirmed := flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey != "" || flow.ConfirmationDigest != "" || flow.ConfirmedAt != nil
	if confirmed != (flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey != "" && projectDigest(flow.ConfirmationDigest) && flow.ConfirmedAt != nil && validCoursePlanUUID(flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey)) {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
	}
	ready := flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest != "" || flow.ReadyCandidateDigest != "" || flow.ReadyContractDigest != "" ||
		flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest != "" || flow.ReadyVerificationDigest != "" || flow.ReadyAt != nil
	if ready != (projectDigest(flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest) && projectDigest(flow.ReadyCandidateDigest) &&
		projectDigest(flow.ReadyContractDigest) && projectDigest(flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest) &&
		projectDigest(flow.ReadyVerificationDigest) && flow.ReadyAt != nil) {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
	}
	publishRequested := flow.PublicationIdempotencyKey != "" || flow.PublicationRequestDigest != "" || flow.PublicationRequestedAt != nil
	if publishRequested != (validCoursePlanUUID(flow.PublicationIdempotencyKey) && projectDigest(flow.PublicationRequestDigest) && flow.PublicationRequestedAt != nil) {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
	}
	published := flow.Publication != nil || flow.PublicationReceiptDigest != "" || flow.PublishedAt != nil
	if flow.Staging != nil && flow.Status != ProjectAuthoringStaged && flow.Status != ProjectAuthoringFailed {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if published {
		if flow.Publication == nil || !projectDigest(flow.PublicationReceiptDigest) || flow.PublishedAt == nil ||
			ValidateProjectPublicationReceipt(*flow.Publication, flow) != nil {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
		digest, err := ProjectPublicationReceiptDigest(*flow.Publication)
		if err != nil || digest != flow.PublicationReceiptDigest {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if flow.TZAuthoringJobID != "" && !validCoursePlanUUID(flow.TZAuthoringJobID) ||
		flow.TZJobStatus != "" && !validTZAuthoringStatus(flow.TZJobStatus) ||
		flow.ClaimToken != "" && !validCoursePlanUUID(flow.ClaimToken) {
		return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
	}
	switch flow.Status {
	case ProjectAuthoringProposed:
		if confirmed || flow.TZAuthoringJobID != "" || ready || publishRequested || published {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case ProjectAuthoringConfirmed:
		if !confirmed || flow.TZAuthoringJobID != "" || ready || publishRequested || published {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case ProjectAuthoringAuthoring:
		if !confirmed || ready || publishRequested || published {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case ProjectAuthoringReady:
		if !confirmed || flow.TZAuthoringJobID == "" || !ready || published {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case ProjectAuthoringPublished:
		if !confirmed || flow.TZAuthoringJobID == "" || !ready || !publishRequested || !published {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case ProjectAuthoringStaged:
		job := TZAuthoringJob{ID: flow.TZAuthoringJobID, CandidateDigest: flow.ReadyCandidateDigest, BlueprintDigest: flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest}
		if !confirmed || !ready || published || publishRequested || flow.Staging == nil || flow.TZJobStatus != TZAuthoringStaged || ValidateProjectStagingReceipt(*flow.Staging, job) != nil {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case ProjectAuthoringFailed:
		if flow.FailureCode == "" || len(flow.FailureCode) > 64 {
			return ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return flow, nil
}

func ValidateProjectOwnerSnapshot(flow ProjectAuthoringFlow, profile StudentPlanningProfile, path LearningPathPlanningState) error {
	if err := ValidateCurrentProjectAuthoringOwnerState(profile, path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if path.StudentID != flow.StudentID || path.LearningPathID != flow.LearningPathID ||
		path.PathVersion != flow.LearningPathVersion || path.GoalCode != flow.GoalCode {
		return ErrConflict
	}
	digest, err := ProjectPathSnapshotDigest(path)
	if err != nil || digest != flow.PathSnapshotDigest {
		return ErrConflict
	}
	profileDigest, err := ProjectAuthoringProfileDigest(profile)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if profile.OnboardingVersion != flow.AuthoringProfileVersion || profileDigest != flow.AuthoringProfileDigest {
		return ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func validateProjectAuthoringInput(flow ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	input := flow.Input
	if input.Schema != ProjectAuthoringInputSchemaV1 || input.GoalCode != flow.GoalCode ||
		(input.Locale != "ru" && input.Locale != "en") || !validProjectStacks(input.Stacks) ||
		len(input.Targets) == 0 || len(input.Targets) > 100 || input.Manifest == "" || len(input.Manifest) > 64<<10 ||
		!projectDigest(input.InputHash) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if normalized, err := NormalizeTargetRefs(input.Targets); err != nil || !equalTargetRefs(normalized, input.Targets) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	inputHash, err := ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
		Schema   string      `json:"schema"`
		GoalCode string      `json:"goal_code"`
		Locale   string      `json:"locale"`
		Stacks   []string    `json:"stacks"`
		Targets  []TargetRef `json:"targets"`
		Manifest string      `json:"manifest"`
	}{input.Schema, input.GoalCode, input.Locale, input.Stacks, input.Targets, input.Manifest})
	if err != nil || inputHash != input.InputHash {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	request := flow.AuthoringRequest
	if ValidateProjectTZAuthoringRequest(request) != nil || request.Manifest != input.Manifest ||
		request.Locale != input.Locale || request.Source.Type != "user_intent" || !request.Source.Anonymized ||
		request.Orchestration.Schema != TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1 || request.Orchestration.Trigger != "planner_recommendation" ||
		request.Orchestration.CorrelationID != flow.ID || request.Orchestration.SurfaceClassification != "project" ||
		!equalStrings(request.Hints.Stacks, input.Stacks) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	digest, err := ProjectAuthoringDigest(request)
	if err != nil || digest != flow.AuthoringInputDigest {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func projectTargets(items []LearningPathItem) ([]TargetRef, error) {
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	result := make([]TargetRef, 0)
	for _, item := range items {
		for _, target := range item.Targets {
			normalized, err := NormalizeTargetRef(target)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			identity := TargetIdentity(normalized)
			if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
				continue
			}
			seen[identity] = struct{}{}
			result = append(result, normalized)
			if len(result) > 100 {
				return nil, ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	if len(result) == 0 {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

func projectAuthoringLocale(language string) (string, error) {
	language = normalizeCode(language)
	switch {
	case language == "ru" || strings.HasPrefix(language, "ru-"):
		return "ru", nil
	case language == "en" || strings.HasPrefix(language, "en-"):
		return "en", nil
	default:
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
}

func projectAuthoringStacks(values []string) ([]string, error) {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		value = normalizeCode(value)
		switch value {
		case "js", "ecmascript":
			value = "javascript"
		case "golang":
			value = "go"
		case "html5":
			value = "html"
		case "css3":
			value = "css"
		}
		if value == "" || len(value) > 64 {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[value]; duplicate {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	if len(result) == 0 || len(result) > 16 {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result, nil
}

func validProjectStacks(values []string) bool {
	canonical, err := projectAuthoringStacks(values)
	return err == nil && equalStrings(canonical, values)
}

func projectAuthoringManifest(goalCode string, targets []TargetRef) (string, error) {
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Schema   string      `json:"schema"`
		GoalCode string      `json:"goal_code"`
		Targets  []TargetRef `json:"targets"`
	}{"planner-project-authoring-manifest.v1", goalCode, targets})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return string(encoded), nil
}

func projectDigest(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 71 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(value[7:])
	return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
}

func boundedProjectKey(value string) bool {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	return value != "" && len(value) <= 128
}

func validProjectAuthoringStatus(status ProjectAuthoringStatus) bool {
	return status == ProjectAuthoringProposed || status == ProjectAuthoringConfirmed ||
		status == ProjectAuthoringAuthoring || status == ProjectAuthoringReady ||
		status == ProjectAuthoringPublished || status == ProjectAuthoringStaged || status == ProjectAuthoringFailed
}

func validTZAuthoringStatus(status TZAuthoringJobStatus) bool {
	return status == TZAuthoringPlanned || status == TZAuthoringGenerating || status == TZAuthoringVerifying ||
		status == TZAuthoringReady || status == TZAuthoringStaged || status == TZAuthoringFailed
}

func equalTargetRefs(left, right []TargetRef) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func equalStrings(left, right []string) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func equalCanonicalCodes(values []string) bool {
	return equalStrings(values, normalizeCodes(values))
}
